scope: Prospective exit-management simulation. Entry rules are unchanged. An early exit is allowed only after entry and only when the specified early MAE/MFE condition is observed; otherwise the original backtest exit is retained.

methodology.split: One shared chronological DEV/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT partition; boundaries are fixed for every candidate.
methodology.search: 7 horizons x 4 MAE thresholds x 4 MFE thresholds = 112 fixed hypotheses.
methodology.trigger: At the close of horizon H, exit if early MAE >= threshold and early MFE < threshold. If the original SL/TP exit occurred before or on H, the original exit is retained.
methodology.execution: Early-exit price is the close of the H-th post-entry candle. This is intentionally conservative and deterministic.
methodology.selectionGate: DEV and VALIDATION each n >= 10, PF >= 1, avgR > 0. Candidates are ranked on VALIDATION only. HOLDOUT is untouched until final evaluation.
methodology.multipleComparisons: The fixed grid is exploratory; any positive holdout result is evidence for a follow-up pre-specified robustness test, not a production rule.
methodology.noEntryLookahead: The condition uses only candles available after the trade entry.
